scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@vanishing/framework && npm run build --workspace=@demo/components
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently -n fw,demo -c blue,green "npm run dev:fw" "npm run dev:demo"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n fw,demo,app -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:fw" "npm run dev:demo" "npm run dev:native"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace=native-signals-example
scripts.start:native: npm run build:packages && npm run start --workspace=native-signals-example
scripts.start:solid: npm run build:packages && npm run start --workspace=solid-signals-example
scripts.start:static: npm run build --workspace=@vanishing/framework && npm run start --workspace=static-example
